LAAuthenticationRequirement.doc: A set of requirements that protect a right.

LABiometryFallbackRequirement.doc: A set of requirements to fall back on if biometrics aren’t present.

LAContext.doc: A mechanism for evaluating authentication policies and access controls.

LAPersistedRight.doc: A right that gates access to a key and a secret.

LAPrivateKey.doc: The private portion of an asymmetric key pair.

LAPublicKey.doc: The public portion of an asymmetric key pair.

LARight.doc: A grouped set of requirements that gate access to a resource or operation.

LARightStore.doc: A container for data protected by a right.

LASecret.doc: Data that’s protected by a persisted right.

LAAccessControlOperation.doc: Operations to be evaluated for access control.

LAAccessControlOperationCreateItem.doc: Specifies that access control is used for item creation.

LAAccessControlOperationCreateKey.doc: Specifies that access control is used for key creation.

LAAccessControlOperationUseItem.doc: Specifies that access control is used for accessing an existing item.

LAAccessControlOperationUseKeyDecrypt.doc: Specifies that access control is used for data decryption using existing key.

LAAccessControlOperationUseKeyKeyExchang.doc: Specifies that access control is used for key exchange.

LAAccessControlOperationUseKeySign.doc: Specifies that access control is used for accessing an existing key.

LABiometryType.doc: The set of available biometric authentication types.

LACredentialType.doc: The types of credentials to be used for authentication.

LACredentialTypeApplicationPassword.doc: Specifies that a password is provided by the application.

LAError.doc: Errors issued by the LocalAuthentication framework.

LAPolicy.doc: The set of available local authentication policies.

LAPolicyDeviceOwnerAuthentication.doc: User authentication with biometry, Apple Watch, or the device passcode.

LAPolicyDeviceOwnerAuthenticationWithBio.doc: Device owner will be authenticated by biometry or a companion device e.g. Watch, Mac, etc.
User authentication with either biometry or Apple Watch.

LAPolicyDeviceOwnerAuthenticationWithCom.doc: Device owner will be authenticated by a companion device e.g. Watch, Mac, etc.

LAPolicyDeviceOwnerAuthenticationWithWri.doc: User authentication with wrist detection on watchOS.

+biometryRequirementWithFallback:.doc: Creates a requirement that requires biometric authentication or a fallback requirement that you specify.

-canEvaluatePolicy:error:.doc: Assesses whether authentication can proceed for a given policy.

-evaluateAccessControl:operation:localiz.doc: Evaluates an access control for a given operation.

-isCredentialSet:.doc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether the specified credential type is set.

-setCredential:type:.doc: Sets an application-provided credential to be used when evaluating authentication.

-stateHashForCompanionType:.doc: Returns state hash data for the given companion type.

-canDecryptUsingSecKeyAlgorithm:.doc: Checks whether the algorithm you supply is valid for decrypting data with the key.

-canExchangeKeysUsingSecKeyAlgorithm:.doc: Checks whether the algorithm you supply is valid for performing key exchanges.

-canSignUsingSecKeyAlgorithm:.doc: Checks whether the algorithm you supply is valid for signing data with the key.

-decryptData:secKeyAlgorithm:completion:.doc: Decrypts the data you supply with a given algorithm.

-exchangeKeysWithPublicKey:secKeyAlgorit.doc: Performs a Diffie-Hellman style key exchange operation.

-signData:secKeyAlgorithm:completion:.doc: Generates a digital signature for the data you supply.

-canEncryptUsingSecKeyAlgorithm:.doc: Checks whether the algorithm you supply is valid for encrypting data with the key.

-canVerifyUsingSecKeyAlgorithm:.doc: Checks whether the algorithm you supply is valid for verifying signatures with the key.

-encryptData:secKeyAlgorithm:completion:.doc: Encrypts the data you supply with a given algorithm.

-exportBytesWithCompletion:.doc: Exports the data that represents a public key.

-verifyData:signature:secKeyAlgorithm:co.doc: Verifies a digital signature for the data you supply.

-authorizeWithLocalizedReason:completion.doc: Performs an authorization on the right.

-authorizeWithLocalizedReason:inPresenta.doc: Performs an authorization on the right with a window context you supply.

-checkCanAuthorizeWithCompletion:.doc: Checks whether the right has permission to perform authorization.

-init.doc: Creates a right using the default authorization requirements.

-initWithRequirement:.doc: Creates a right with the authentication requirements you supply.

-removeAllRightsWithCompletion:.doc: Removes all rights associated with this client from the right store.

-removeRight:completion:.doc: Removes a right from the right store given an instance of that right.

-removeRightForIdentifier:completion:.doc: Removes a right from the right store given its unique identifier.

-rightForIdentifier:completion:.doc: Fetches a previously stored right from the shared right store.

-saveRight:identifier:completion:.doc: Saves a right to a persistent right store.

-saveRight:identifier:secret:completion:.doc: Saves a right to a persistent store along with secret data you supply.

-loadDataWithCompletion:.doc: Retrieves data stored in a secret.

biometryCurrentSetRequirement.doc: The requirement that requires user authentication with the current set of biometrics.

biometryRequirement.doc: The requirement that requires biometric authentication.

defaultRequirement.doc: The requirement that requires user authentication.

devicePasscodeRequirement.doc: The fallback requirement that requires entering the device passcode.

biometryType.doc: The type of biometric authentication supported by the device.

evaluatedPolicyDomainState.doc: The current state of the evaluated policy domain.

interactionNotAllowed.doc: A Boolean value indicating whether authentication can be interactive.

localizedCancelTitle.doc: The localized title for the cancel button in the dialog presented to the user during authentication.

localizedFallbackTitle.doc: The localized title for the fallback button in the dialog presented to the user during authentication.

localizedReason.doc: The localized explanation for authentication shown in the dialog presented to the user.

maxBiometryFailures.doc: The number of biometric authentication failures after which the context falls back to another mechanism.

touchIDAuthenticationAllowableReuseDurat.doc: The duration for which Touch ID authentication reuse is allowable.

stateHash.doc: Contains combined state hash data for biometry and companion state hashes.

biometryType.doc: Indicates biometry type available on the device.

stateHash.doc: Contains state hash data for the available biometry type. Returns nil if no biometry entities are enrolled.

availableCompanionTypes.doc: Indicates types of companions paired with the device. The elements are NSNumber-wrapped instances of @c LACompanionType.

stateHash.doc: Contains combined state hash data for all available companion types. . Returns nil if no companion devices are paired.

key.doc: The private key that’s persisted by the right.

secret.doc: The data kept secret by the right.

publicKey.doc: The public key that corresponds with the private key in a key pair.

LARightState.doc: The possible states for a right during authorization.

state.doc: The current authorization state for a right.

tag.doc: An integer you use to identify a right.

sharedStore.doc: A shared object that stores rights.
